skills.name: Subtract same-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts with a common denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, and handling zero fractional results.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fractions and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions before subtracting.

skills.name: Separate and combine mixed or whole numbers
skills.definition: Represent whole numbers, fractions, and mixed numbers in compatible whole-plus-fraction form, subtract whole-number parts, and combine the final whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Borrow for fractional subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into fractional units when the minuend fractional part is too small to subtract the subtrahend fractional part.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result or mixed-number fractional part to lowest terms.
